HeadingPath: 8 Study Assessments and Procedures > 8.2 Safety Assessments > 8.2.1 Vital Signs
Markdown: Vital signs (including temperature) will be assessed pre-dose and at 2 h (±10 min), 4 h (±15 min) and 8 h (±20 min) post-dose on Day 1, and at 24 h (±60 min) on Day 2. If systolic blood pressure exceeds 160 mmHg at any assessment, vital signs should be repeated after 10 minutes.

HeadingPath: 8 Study Assessments and Procedures > 8.2 Safety Assessments > 8.2.2 Injection Site Reactions
Markdown: Injection site reactions will be assessed every 2 hours for the first 8 hours after dosing (±15 min).

HeadingPath: 8 Study Assessments and Procedures > 8.2 Safety Assessments > 8.2.3 Electrocardiograms
Markdown: A single 12-lead ECG will be recorded, in triplicate approximately 2 minutes apart, pre-dose and at 2 h (±10 min) and 4 h (±15 min) post-dose on Day 1.

HeadingPath: 8 Study Assessments and Procedures > 8.4 Pharmacokinetics > 8.4.2 PK Sampling
Markdown: Pharmacokinetic blood samples will be collected pre-dose and at 0.5 h (±10 min), 1 h (±10 min), 4 h (±15 min) and 8 h (±20 min) post-dose on Day 1, and at 24 h (±60 min) on Day 2. An additional pharmacokinetic sample will be collected at 2 h (±10 min) post-dose on Day 1 to support exploratory metabolite profiling. Pharmacokinetic parameters will be derived using non-compartmental analysis.

Exploratory pharmacodynamic biomarkers (serum TL1A) will be assessed according to the schedule of activities. An exploratory skin biopsy will be collected at 96 h on Day 4 to support tissue-level analyses. Biopsy handling and shipment are described in the laboratory manual.

A total of 24 participants will be enrolled. Assuming a between-participant coefficient of variation of 30%, this sample size provides at least 80% power to detect a 25% difference in the primary endpoint at a two-sided significance level of 0.05. No formal hypothesis testing is planned for secondary endpoints.
